## Type of change

- [ ] Fix (typo, broken link, wrong command or number)
- [ ] Improvement to an existing week (clearer explanation, better exercise)
- [ ] New content (case study, exercise, resource, translation)
- [ ] Data or script change
- [ ] Course structure / contribution process

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `python scripts/lint_course.py` and it passes
- [ ] Any command I added or changed was **run by me** and the output in the page matches what I saw
- [ ] Every new link points to a real page I opened; every new reference is a real publication (no invented citations)
- [ ] I did not add real patient data, personal data or large files (`contribute/data-policy.md`)
- [ ] If I changed a number in the toy data, I regenerated `data/CHECKSUMS.sha256` and updated every page that quotes it
- [ ] I added my name to `contribute/CONTRIBUTORS.md` (optional, but we would love to credit you)
